marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 打开故宫 | Da kai gu gong

Opening the Forbidden City" adopts the design form of flipping up and down, and displays the important scenes and buildings on the central axis of the Forbidden City in the form of miniature three-dimensional models to readers, allowing readers to walk to the "real" paper on the Forbidden City without leaving the house. Enjoy the glory and magnificence of the Forbidden City's architecture, and feel the profound and mysterious culture of the Forbidden City. In addition to the beautiful and realistic model of the Forbidden City, the book is also interspersed with rich creative interactions and event organs, which can bring readers unlimited surprises and deepen the understanding of the Forbidden City. This book is suitable for children and adults over 6 years old. It combines the traditional classic three-dimensional paper art with the profound and long-established culture of the Forbidden City. It combines fun and knowledge, and gives the ancient Forbidden City a new vigor and vitality
